title: UXID conformance corpus manifest
description: manifest.json: the corpus version, the case files in a fixed order, and a hash over their bytes.

corpus_version.description: The version of the corpus shape.

files.description: The case files, in the order the hash reads them.

kind.description: The case kind; every case id in the file starts with it and a slash.

file.description: The case file, relative to the manifest.

case_count.description: The number of lines (cases) in the file.

corpus_hash.description: `sha256:` and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the case files' bytes concatenated in the order of `files`.
